source: Claude, d'après l'arbre du dépôt et le README
explication_en: The Makefile concatenates the files in src/ into a single zsh script, zsh-autosuggestions.zsh, loaded by the plugin file. Suggestion retrieval (fetch.zsh) queries the history, completion or match_prev_cmd strategies, optionally asynchronously.
